_comment: Default grid of the c sweep. c is the only shape parameter of the BiT layer: towards c = 1 the degrees equalise, large c approaches a single super-hub. Above c = 20 k_max hits the N-1 ceiling and c = 1.0 degenerates on low-mean-degree graphs; both cases are marked in the row rather than silently clipped.
note: 1.6 is the deployed value; 1.0 and 1.2 show the lower-bound degeneracy; 20 and 50 show the upper-end truncation.
